name: Man As Head Of Household
overview: Scripture reveals that God created the man as the first and primary leader within the household, establishing the woman as a suitable helper for him, highlighting the complementary roles within marriage (Genesis 2:18). The Apostle Paul further clarifies this divine order by instructing wives to submit to their husbands as to the Lord, affirming the husband's role as the head of the wife just as Christ is the head of the church (Ephesians 5:22-23). This headship is not merely positional but reflects Christ's loving and sacrificial leadership as the Savior of the body, underscoring the responsibility and honor entrusted to the man in the family structure.
